authoritative_for: Job Packets owns its private captured inputs, brief and Jackson-bullet preparation, accepted stage results, rendered resumes, dated editions, opportunity exclusion state and recorded email submission outcome. Independent ad hoc test occurrences own their frozen payload and receipt without changing normal packet sent history.
not_authoritative_for: Cast owns discovery evidence; CRM owns career entries; external employers own hiring facts; Nucleus owns execution; Email and Resend own submission acceptance; Gmail owns final receipt.

covers: All prototype Job Packets CLI outcomes for initialization, preparation, normal and ad hoc edition preview, explicit send and local status in this source release.
excludes: Help/version, installation, production scheduling, automatic application submission, employer contact, CRM writes and final inbox delivery observation.

shared_access_and_trust: The current-user CLI operates one private state directory. Models receive only captured source material and narrow requester tools. This source bundle does not establish an installed command, service or send authority. Ad hoc tests can read retained artifacts without source refresh and choose a tested Email executable only for that invocation.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Original resume, captured CRM entries, posting text, model inputs/results, evidence references, PDFs, editions and send outcomes are private retained data. Nucleus/model processing receives career material; explicit send discloses the brief and resume attachments to Email, Resend and Gmail.
compatibility_and_retirement: Prototype package/provider release 0.1.0, contract version 1 and private state schema 1 are distinct. No upgrade or migration promise is made; do not replace original resume state under an existing preparation.
operational_limits: Up to three new ready packets per edition; no candidate or token budget. Model is gpt-5.6-sol at max effort. Stored 09:00 America/Chicago setting does not install or enable a schedule. External source, runtime and rendering readiness must be checked separately.
